mapper.select: select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) portfolioId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME portfolioName,/**金融产品名称**/ hgzc.TERM term, /**回购期限**/ mst.COUNTER_ID counterId, /**交易对手**/ t.PS ps,/**交易类型**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.VDATE vdate,/**起息日**/ t.MDATE mdate,/**到期日**/ hgzc.PRIN prinAmt, /**本金金额**/ hgzc.INT_RATE*100 rebackPrice, /**回购利率**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt, /**回购利息**/ NVL(ttfd.FEE_AMT,0) brokerage,/**经手费**/ NVL(ttfd1.FEE_AMT,0) stlAmt,/**结算费**/ NVL(ttfd2.FEE_AMT,0) commission,/**佣金**/ NVL(ttfd3.FEE_AMT,0) dealFeeAmt,/**交易手续费**/ NVL(ttfd4.FEE_AMT,0) settFeeAmt,/**结算手续费**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B99' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as otherAmt,/**其他应付费用**/ CASE WHEN t.PS in('03','04') THEN hgzc.PRIN+NVL(ttfd.FEE_AMT,0)+NVL(ttfd1.FEE_AMT,0)+NVL(ttfd2.FEE_AMT,0)+NVL(ttfd3.FEE_AMT,0)+NVL(ttfd4.FEE_AMT,0) ELSE hgzc.PRIN+t.INT_AMT+0 END AS settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ t.MY_ACCT_NO trdAcctId/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdp on t.finprod_id=fdp.finprod_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.FINPROD_ID=fdp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT hgzc on t.FINPROD_ID=hgzc.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT hgzc on hgzc.finprod_id = fdp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mst on mst.COUNTER_ID = t.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='05' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B01' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd1 ON ttfd1.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd1.FEE_TYPE = 'B07' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd2 ON ttfd2.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd2.FEE_TYPE = 'B05' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd3 ON ttfd3.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd3.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd4 ON ttfd4.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND ttfd4.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='04'
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and deal.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{portfolioId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND t.PS IN
#{ps}
AND t.TRADE_MARKET IN
#{tradeMarket}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc
